notes: Ablations (approved 2026-11-20). Every run uses the SAME short budget: 8 epochs x 2000 steps = 16k steps
(~2.5 GPU h each at v2 data speed ~0.56 s/step; 6 runs ~15 h), compared with abl_ref (full model, same budget), not with the 60k main run.
Each run is evaluated once on synthetic sets and once in the final real evaluation; none is selected for use.
model_config = the recipe of the reported model: model_v2.json if v2 wins on val_font_hard (rule of 2026-11-22), else set back to model_v1.json before running.
